sections.briefing_summary: 本期覆盖前沿模型、AI 产品与平台、研究与治理三组进展：论文提出模型间潜在互联、检索代理搜索状态自评估、面向稀疏专家模型的 KV 缓存压缩，以及用扩散语言模型加速深度研究；Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet 并开放候补，1Password 支持 AI 代理代登录而不暴露密码，OpenAI 广泛开放其决策模型，微软诊断系统在 Science 研究的疑难病例上优于全科医生但提升主要来自底层模型；研究侧发布 Agent4Sci 科学代理测试平台，评估 Jev 作为低成本临床评审，筛查医疗 AI 成员推断隐私风险，Anthropic 将 Agent Skills 标准捐赠给 Linux 基金会下的 Agentic AI Foundation。
sections.briefing_title_en: AI and Large Models: Agent Deployment, Inference Efficiency and Medical Governance Advance Together
sections.briefing_summary_en: This briefing covers three groups of developments across frontier models, AI products and platforms, and research and governance. Papers propose latent inter-model interconnection, self-assessment of search state for retrieval agents, KV cache compression for sparse mixture-of-experts models, and diffusion language models to accelerate deep research. Anthropic launched Claude Duet with a waitlist, 1Password enabled AI agents to log in on users' behalf without exposing passwords, OpenAI made its decision model widely available, and Microsoft's diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases in a Science study, though most of the improvement came from the underlying models. On research and governance, Agent4Sci was introduced as a long-horizon scientific agent testbed, Jev was evaluated as a lower-cost clinical judge, automated screening targeted membership-inference privacy risks in medical AI, and Anthropic donated the Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation.
